front.title: A Discovery Document and Signed Catalogue for Capability Marketplaces

abstract.t: Autonomous software agents obtain capabilities from services catalogued by independently operated indexes. For an agent, or another index, to use such a catalogue it must first learn a small set of public properties of the index: what it is called, which protocol versions it speaks, where its catalogue is, and which key signs that catalogue. This document specifies a JSON discovery document served at a well-known URI that carries exactly those properties, and the requirements a signed catalogue referenced from it has to meet so that a reader can verify it without trusting the transport or the operator. It specifies nothing about how indexes find one another, exchange catalogues, or decide whom to trust; those are the subject of a companion document.
